entries.name: init
entries.successSemantics: Resolves once the instance is ready; idempotent for the same source and limits.
entries.invalidInputSemantics: TypeError for missing/both/wrong sources or wrongly typed limits; RangeError for invalid limit values; H3InitializationError for a different source or limits, or a failed compile/instantiate (cause attached).
